Meldrum lays out the footprint casts and sighting reports he finds hard to dismiss. Trussell keeps the talk loose, joking through the stranger claims while still poking at real ones. Rogan moves between doubt and wonder as host. The episode shows the early show's mix of science, myth, and stand-up humor.
